questions.question:
**Identify the segment in the sentence which contains the grammatical error.**

Zainab was played with / her friends in the park / when she noticed Disha / walking away with a stranger.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2.**

The error lies in part 1 of the sentence. **'played'** should be replaced with past continuous form **'playing'.**

Past continuous tense denotes an action going on at some point of time in the past. Past tense form of the verb makes the sentence grammatically incorrect.

The correct sentence will be: *Zainab __was playing__ with her friends in the park when she noticed Disha walking away with a stranger.*

questions.question:
**Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank and make a meaningful sentence.**

Mahesh is very happy because the value of his shares has _____.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is appreciated.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

Reading the above sentence we find that: 

__
 
• 
 The person Mahesh the subject of the sentence is very happy with the **value of his shares. **
 
 
• 
 Normally a person becomes happy when the value of her/his shares increase. 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

The word appreciated has three meanings, depending upon the context in which it is used. 

__
 
• 
 Here the context is the increasing value of the shares. 
 
 
• 
 Therefore, the meaning of appreciated according to the context is 'rise in value or price.' 
 

Thus the correct answer is appreciated.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Let's look at the meaning of the other options. 

__
 
• 
 Diminished: decreased, declined
 
 
• 
 Complimented: praised politely for something
 
 
• 
 Applauded: cheered, saluted, praised
 

Thus the correct sentence will be: *Mahesh is very happy because the value of his shares has appreciated.__*

questions.question:
Which two numbers should be interchanged to make the below equation mathematically correct?

3 × 6 + 72 ÷ 8 - 24 = 12
questions.solution:
**1) 6, 8**

**Given equation: 3 ****× 6 + 72 ÷ 8 - 24 = 12**

**After interchanging ‘6, 8’, we get:**

**L.H.S = 3 ****× 8 + 72 ÷ 6 - 24 **

**= 24 + 12 – 24**

**= 12 = R.H.S**

2) 24, 3

Given equation: 3 × 6 + 72 ÷ 8 - 24 = 12

After interchanging ’24, 3’, we get:

L.H.S = 24 × 6 + 72 ÷ 8 - 3

= 144 + 9 - 3

= 153 - 3

= 150 ≠ R.H.S

3) 72, 24

Given equation: 3 × 6 + 72 ÷ 8 - 24 = 12

After interchanging ’72, 24’, we get:

L.H.S = 3 × 6 + 24 ÷ 8 - 72

= 18 + 3 - 72

= 21 - 72

= -51 ≠ R.H.S

4) 3, 8

Given equation: 3 × 6 + 72 ÷ 8 - 24 = 12

After interchanging ‘3, 8’, we get:

L.H.S = 8 × 6 + 72 ÷ 3 - 24

= 48 + 24 - 24

= 48 ≠ R.H.S

Hence, ‘6, 8’ is the correct answer

questions.question:
Three Statements are given followed by four conclusions numbered I, II , III and IV Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

1. All boys are experts.

2. Some experts are travelers.

3. All travelers are foreigners.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some foreigners are experts.

II. Some foreigners are boys.

III. No foreigner is boy.

IV. All travelers are experts.

options.text: Conclusion IV and Either II or III follows
Conclusion I, II and IV follow
Conclusion I and Either II or III follows

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9c174238e4b2350538c6b07767129f7f5e84a280c746795b76cea6efaeba855f.png] 

I. Some foreigners are experts. → True

II. Some foreigners are boys. → False (It is possible, but it is not definite)

III. No foreigner is boy. → False (It is possible, but it is not definite)

IV. All travelers are experts. → False (It is possible, but it is not definite)

But, conclusion II and III forms a complementary pair.

Hence, conclusion I and either II or III follows.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e085a7f17645c801966c030eb44d69fae944b96fdb4c4077f5fba1bc2c24bc71.png] **__Mistake Points__**

.’Some’ is a subset of ‘All’. If in statements it is given that ‘All A are B’ then the conclusion ‘Some A are B’ would always be True.

questions.question: A pipe can fill a tank in 56 hours, but it takes 16 hours more due to a leak in its bottom. In how much time (in hours) can the leak alone empty 83(1)/(3)%of the tank?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Time for Filling Pipe (A) = 56 hours

Time for (A + Leak) = 56 + 16 = 72 hours

Leak efficiency = (72 − 56) / (72 × 56) per unit = 16 / (72 × 56) = 1 / 252

Time for leak to empty full tank = 252 hours

Time to empty 83(1/3)% (i.e., 5/6 portion) = 252 × 5/6 = 42 × 5 = 210 hours

**∴ The correct answer is 210 hours.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Filling time = 56 hours, Time with leak = 56 + 16 = 72 hours.

**Formula Used:** Total Work = LCM of time; Efficiency = Total Work ÷ Time.

 **Pipe**
 **Time (hrs)**
 **Total Work (LCM)**
 **Efficiency**

 Inlet (A)
 56
 504
 9

 Inlet + Leak (A + B)
 72
 7

⇒ Efficiency of Leak (B) = Efficiency of (A + B) − Efficiency of (A)

⇒ Efficiency of Leak (B) = 7 − 9 = −2 (Negative sign indicates emptying)

⇒ Capacity to be emptied = 83(1/3)% of 504 = 5/6 × 504 = 420 units

⇒ Time taken by Leak = Capacity ÷ Efficiency = 420 ÷ 2

⇒ Time taken = 210 hours

**∴ The correct answer is 210 hours.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Fraction Conversion

83(1/3)% is a standard fraction equivalent to 5/6. It can be calculated as (250/3) ÷ 100 = 250/300 = 5/6.

Leakage Concept

When a leak is present, the net efficiency decreases. Net efficiency = Inlet efficiency − Leakage efficiency.

Time and Work Relation

If an inlet fills in 'x' hours and with a leak it fills in 'y' hours, the leak alone empties the tank in (xy) / (y − x) hours.</p

questions.question: A boat goes a distance of 3 km upstream and 4(1)/(2) km downstream in 45 minutes, while it goes 3.6 km upstream and 2.4 km downstream in 39 minutes. The speed (in km/h) of the boat when going downstream is:
questions.solution:
Let speed of boat and stream be x km/hr and y km/hr,

Upstream speed = (x - y) km/hr

Downstream speed = (x + y) km/hr

According to the question

⇒ 3/(x - y) + 4.5/(x + y) = 45/60 --- (1)

⇒ 3.6/(x - y) + 2.4/(x + y) = 39/60 --- (2)

After multiply by 1.2 in equation (1) subtract equation (2) from equation (1)

⇒ 3/(x + y) = 1/4

⇒ x + y = 12 km/hr

∴ Downstream speed is 12 km/hr.

• It is the complex tissue that acts as a transport system for soluble organic compounds within vascular plants.
 
• It transports the food made in leaves to other parts of plants.
 
• It is made up of living tissue, which uses turgor pressure and energy in the form of ATP to actively transport sugars to the plant organs
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• Xylem

 
 
• It is a type of tissue in vascular plants that transports water and some nutrients from the roots to the leaves.
 
• The tissue consists of a variety of specialized, water-conducting cells known as tracheary elements.
 
 
 
• Root hairs
 
 
• These are cylindrical extensions of root epidermal cells.
 
• The primary function is to collect water and mineral nutrients from the soil. It takes the solution up by the roots to the rest of the plant.
 
 
 
• Epiblema
 
 
• Epidermis with root hairs is called epiblema.
 
• It is composed of one layer of compactly arranged parenchymatous cells.
 
• It is usually located between the epidermis and cortex in the root or stem of a plant.
 
• The root hairs and thin-walled epiblema cells absorb water and minerals salts from the soil.

questions.question: Which of the following disease is NOT transmitted through water?
questions.solution:
__**Measles**__ is not transmitted through water.

It is a **viral disease** that spreads through sneezing and coughing.

__Explanation:__

Water-Borne diseases: 

These are conditions caused by pathogenic micro-organisms that are transmitted in water. The disease can spread while bathing, washing or drinking water, or by eating food exposed to infected water and can cause severe, life-threatening diseases. Examples are typhoid fever, cholera and Hepatitis A or E. Other microorganisms induce less dangerous diseases such as diarrhoea. 

__
 
• Cholera: Cholera is a waterborne disease and is diarrhoeal in nature.
 
• Typhoid: It is another disease that gets transmitted by drinking contaminated water that carries ‘Salmonellae Typhi bacteria’.
 
• Diarrhoea: Diarrhoea is one of the most common waterborne diseases that mostly affects children under the age of 5.
 
• Hepatitis A: Another type of waterborne disease is Hepatitis A and it is caused by Hepatitis A virus, which affects the liver.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 **Diseases**
 **Type; Spreads through**
 
 

 Measles
 Viral infection; spreads through sneezing and coughing
 
 

 Typhoid
 Bacterial; contaminated food and water
 
 

 Hepatitis A
 Viral; contaminated food and water
 
 

 Cholera
 Bacterial; water

questions.question: Dialysis is recommended to a patient having which human organ damaged or not working properly?
questions.solution:
**Dialysis** is recommended to a patient having __**kidney**__ damaged or not working properly.

 
• It is a treatment that removes salt, waste, and extra water from the body and helps control blood pressure.
 
• Kidneys are bean-shaped organs that are responsible for filtering blood in the body.
 
• It helps maintain the right levels of electrolytes, control the body's fluid balance, and removes waste.
 
• However, when it stops functioning normally, that is when dialysis is required.

questions.question: A narrow passage of water connecting two large water bodies like seas and oceans is called ________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 4 i.e., __Strait.__

__
 
• A narrow passage of water connecting two large water bodies like seas and oceans is called **strait**__.
 
• Example - Strait of Malacca.
 
• A **lagoon** is a water body separated from larger water bodies by a natural barrier.
 
• A narrow strip of land that separates two water bodies and connects two larger landmasses is known as an **isthmus**.
 
• Example - Isthmus of Panama.
 
• A broad inlet or a small water body that is set off from a larger water body where the land curves inward is known as a **bay**.
 
• Example- Bay of Bengal.
